subject.title: Feature: Graceful Gateway Restart with Session Recovery

question: Which restart-continuation policy should OpenClaw core own for the remaining graceful-restart scope: default core recovery, opt-in recovery controls, or narrower per-surface fixes only?
rationale: The remaining behavior affects config defaults, durable state, cron retry semantics, and channel delivery guarantees, and current code plus open PRs show multiple plausible ownership boundaries rather than one mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Keep Umbrella And Split Slices
options.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical umbrella while maintainers decide and land narrower PRs for cron retry, drain replay, readiness policy, and delivery recovery.

options.title: Sponsor One Core Design
options.body: Choose a single core restart-recovery design and ask the related PRs to converge on that architecture before further implementation.

options.title: Limit To Opt-In Extensions
options.body: Keep core conservative and route proactive restart continuation to plugin or opt-in APIs unless a missing core seam blocks it.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella And Split Slices
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical umbrella while maintainers decide and land narrower PRs for cron retry, drain replay, readiness policy, and delivery recovery.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned to this issue and have the strongest recent history on gateway restart drain, cron interrupted-startup behavior, and the active-run partial fix.
